paragraphs: Gallagher Security designs and manufactures integrated security products across access control, perimeter security, intruder alarms, and cybersecurity. Its customers range from small businesses to enterprise organizations and critical infrastructure sites. Systems are sized from a single door to thousands across multiple sites.

Access control runs on card readers, mobile credentials, and biometric devices that verify permissions. Controllers act as the central hub, processing access requests and communicating with connected systems. Roles, schedules, and activity are managed in Command Centre, the company's centralized platform, with customizable dashboards and reporting. On the perimeter, high-tensile pulse fences form a visual barrier and deliver safe, short pulses that deter intruders. Sensors alert a team the moment a fence is touched. Perimeter protection is a native part of Command Centre, the same software that runs access control and intruder detection. It works with most existing fence types, so a site can add detection without replacing its fencing.

The company says it has been doing this work for over 35 years. Listed uses include safeguarding energy plants, utilities, airports, and seaports with multi-layered systems. Another is securing classified areas and complying with defense standards. Published case studies include one on the Indiana Department of Corrections. A featured project spans campus life for students and staff across 143 buildings and 150 research centres.
